# alvo:    ReconcileInputProtection_politica_drop
# cenário: hairpin_1nic
# sobre:   uma VM de nuvem com UMA placa de rede: entra e sai pela mesma interface, e o eixo
#          das regras passa a ser o CIDR de dentro. É o comportamento NOVO, e o contraste
#          com onprem_1wan é o ponto.
# entrada: fontes ligadas: grupos = 1, ntp = ["10.0.0.0/24"]/servindo=true, política =
#          "drop", wans = ["ens3"], gerência fechada = false, contenção = false,
#          wireguard = 51820
# formato: `argv` é o CONTRATO (um token por argumento, entre aspas);
#          `cmd ` é o mesmo comando como se lê no shell.
#          exec = Execute, read = ExecuteRead (o `nft list table` do Persist
#          aparece aqui: é a prova de que o Persist rodou).
# retorno: nil
#
# GERADO POR zonas_golden_test.go. Um diff aqui é uma mudança no que o
# firewall manda ao kernel — nunca edite este arquivo para fazer um teste passar.

 1. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "{" "type" "filter" "hook" "input" "priority" "filter" ";" "policy" "drop" ";" "}"
          cmd   nft add chain inet linkguard input { type filter hook input priority filter ; policy drop ; }
 2. exec  argv  "nft" "flush" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "input"
          cmd   nft flush chain inet linkguard input
 3. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "ct" "state" "related" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input ct state related counter accept
 4. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iif" "lo" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iif lo counter accept
 5. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "icmpv6" "type" "{ nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } counter accept
 6. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "tcp" "dport" "{ 22, 9997 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input tcp dport { 22, 9997 } counter accept
 7. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "udp" "dport" "67" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input udp dport 67 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 8. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "udp" "dport" "53" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input udp dport 53 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 9. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "tcp" "dport" "53" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input tcp dport 53 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
10. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "udp" "dport" "68" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input udp dport 68 counter accept
11. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "udp" "dport" "123" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input udp dport 123 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
12. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "udp" "dport" "123" "counter" "drop"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input udp dport 123 counter drop
13. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "ip" "saddr" "10.0.0.0/24" "counter" "jump" "grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input ip saddr 10.0.0.0/24 counter jump grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b
14. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } counter accept
15. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable } counter accept
16. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "68" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 68 counter accept
17. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "udp" "dport" "546" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname { "ens3" } udp dport 546 counter accept
18. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "status" "dnat" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct status dnat counter accept
19. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "icmp" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } icmp type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
20. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
21. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "tcp" "dport" "{ 22, 9997 }" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } tcp dport { 22, 9997 } counter accept
22. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "51820" "counter" "accept"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 51820 counter accept
23. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "input" "iifname" "!=" "\"lo\"" "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "state" "new" "counter" "drop"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard input iifname != "lo" ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct state new counter drop
24. read  argv  "nft" "list" "table" "inet" "linkguard"
          cmd   nft list table inet linkguard
